worldcombat.skill.lifedew.summary: Mysterious water wells up underfoot and a ring spreads along the ground, washing over the user and nearby allies; each one it sweeps past is restored by a tenth of their maximum health. The ring widens as it travels and recedes when it is done. Surge heals more over a wider ring at the cost of a slower spread and a longer cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.lifedew.use.0: Top up a whole group standing around you at once
worldcombat.skill.lifedew.use.1: Open with a wave that pulls everyone low back up
worldcombat.skill.lifedew.use.2: Stand by an ally so the wave covers them too
worldcombat.skill.lifedew.description.0: When the wave sweeps past, the user and each ally restore %1$s of their maximum health, each target healed only once and never beyond the health it has lost; a higher Special Attack and a deeper wound on the caster raise the fraction.
worldcombat.skill.lifedew.description.1: The wave reaches %1$s blocks, spreading over %2$s seconds; whoever it reaches later waits longer.
worldcombat.skill.lifedew.stance.surge: Surge: x1.15 healing and x1.15 wave radius at the cost of a 1.3x slower spread and a longer cooldown - for pulling a whole group back up.
worldcombat.skill.lifedew.stance.plain: Thin: spreads faster and cheaper with a shorter cooldown, but a smaller ring and less healing - for a quick top-up.
worldcombat.skill.lifedew.timing: Cast on yourself; after %1$s s of wind-up it spends %3$s PP, then recovers for %2$s s with a %4$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.lifedew.growth.0: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.lifedew.growth.1: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens further to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.lifedew.preference.sur: On: x1.15 healing and x1.15 radius with a 1.3x slower spread and a longer cooldown. Off: faster and cheaper, but a smaller ring and less healing.
The wave is planned when the user or an ally is below this health ratio; lower keeps attacking, higher heals at the first wound.
The wave is considered only for a wounded subject within this distance; lower keeps it close, higher closes a gap first.
worldcombat.skill.lifedew.description.ad: It spreads from you as its centre; if no wounded ally (including you) is inside the ring, it cannot be cast.
